weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). If foe initiates combat or foe's HP ≥ 75% at start of combat, grants Atk+6 to unit and inflicts Atk-6 on foe during combat, inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack (only highest value applied; does not stack), restores 7 HP to unit when unit deals damage to foe during combat (triggers even if 0 damage is dealt), and also, if foe can make a follow-up attack, reduces damage from foe's first attack during combat by 75%. If foe's Range = 2, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

special.d: Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.
Treats foe's Def/Res as if reduced by 30% during combat.

a.d: Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.
Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range. If foe initiates combat, grants Res+5 to unit during combat.

b.d: If unit's HP = 100% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 75% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 50% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, inflicts Atk/Res-4 on foe during combat, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack, and also, if foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks.
